transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I've just been feeling incredibly depressed and sad all the time, and I don't know what to do anymore. It's been going on like this for about nine months now, and I feel completely exhausted.
Have you had any period of at least two months during these nine months when you felt back to your usual self?
No, I haven't had any breaks or times where I felt like myself again. It has just been continuous every single day for the entire nine months.
